# `product_offering_price`

Area: **catalog** ([all tables](README.md))

SID ProductOfferingPrice (TMF620 productOfferingPrice): a price created on its own and attached to at most one offering. Never re-priced, never starts in the past, never ended retroactively; prices of one offering, type and currency never overlap.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Last change: the database's now(), maintained by the set_updated_at trigger. |
| `product_offering_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The offering the price is attached to; NULL while unattached (an unattached price prices nothing). Never detached once set. |
| `name` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `price_type` | `price_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | TMF620 priceType: recurring or oneTime. Billing uses recurring only. |
| `recurring_period` | `recurring_charge_period_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | yes |  | TMF620 recurringChargePeriodType (monthly); set iff recurring. |
| `recurring_period_length` | `smallint` | no | `1` | TMF620 recurringChargePeriodLength; always 1. |
| `amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | numeric(12,2), exact (never float); the price for one whole period, never negative. Immutable. |
| `currency` | `character(3)` | no |  | ISO 4217 code, three upper-case letters. Immutable. |
| `valid_for` | `tstzrange` | no |  | TMF620 validFor as a half-open tstzrange [start, end); NULL upper = open-ended. The start never lies in the past and never moves; the end is only set or moved to now or later, and never so that a product is left without a price. |
